title: Spinneys Retail Traffic Up After Initial Iran War Hit

Dubai-listed Spinneys reported profit for 2Q of AED 90.6 million. The retailer says revenue dipped slightly, hit by regional geopolitical tensions that disrupted supply chains and cut store traffic. Video headline and description was edited to add context on the retail footfall improvement in June. (Source: Bloomberg)
